Container.Name: Pokemon-Extender
Container.Overview:
Your favourite card, framed like a graded slab: printed, cut and ready for the acrylic case.
Upload a picture of a Pokémon card whose artwork carries on past the card's edge (painted by hand or extended with any AI tool). Pokemon-Extender finds the card, uses it as a ruler (a card is 63 x 88 mm) and turns the picture into an insert for a PSA- or BGS-style case: a print sheet in the exact size of the slab, with the cut lines for the outline, the label window and the card window.
Downloads: an SVG that Bambu Suite takes as it is for Print Then Cut (H2D/H2S with the cutting module), the print with the cut path for other cutters, PDF/PNG and a DXF. Slab measurements come from templates you can correct. One picture takes a second; no GPU, no AI model, no account. English, Deutsch, Français and Lëtzebuergesch.
There is no login: keep it in your LAN and never forward the port to the internet.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: pokemon tcg trading card slab psa bgs beckett graded print cut cricut bambu suite h2d acrylic case display insert
Container.Requires: No login: anyone who can reach the page can use it. Keep it inside your LAN.
Container.DonateText: Pokemon-Extender is free. If it saved you an afternoon with a craft knife, a coffee is a lovely way to say so.
